records.name: Kaminkehrer Schwarzgenug
records.biography_en: Can tell useful soot from the soot that has acquired a title. His brush removes HyperNorm soot deemed unofficial. A dissonant card asks whether the approved soot is any less dirty. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Ruß ohne Zuständigkeit wird vorrangig entfernt.

variant_notes.note_en: Can tell useful soot from the soot that has acquired a title.

records.name: Waschfrau Seifenruh
records.biography_en: Has washed everything except the assumption that it will stay clean. Her washboard sorts HyperNorm stains into removable and the resident's own fault. A dissonant card arrives with a third kind: somebody else's tears. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Sauberkeit ist hergestellt, vorübergehend.

variant_notes.note_en: Has washed everything except the assumption that it will stay clean.

records.name: Hauswart Nassgenau
records.biography_en: Is still deciding which side of the floor counts as finished. His HyperNorm mop finishes one side of a boundary that keeps moving. A dissonant card proposes letting everyone cross while it dries. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Fertig ist jeweils die andere Hälfte.

variant_notes.note_en: Is still deciding which side of the floor counts as finished.

records.name: Fensterputzer Durchblick
records.biography_en: Improves the view without changing his opinion of it. His squeegee clears HyperNorm windows onto views the building denies possessing. A dissonant card simply enjoys looking out. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Durchblick begründet noch keine Zustimmung.

variant_notes.note_en: Improves the view without changing his opinion of it.

records.name: Dekonwartin Reinstform
records.biography_en: Removes contaminants including several that turn out to be official policy. Her HyperNorm vacuum collects unauthorized particles until a dissonant card asks whether imagination has a permitted grain size. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Rückstand enthält möglicherweise eine gute Idee.

variant_notes.note_en: Removes contaminants including several that turn out to be official policy.

records.name: Staubsammler Restwelt
records.biography_en: Cannot discard the dust until somebody confirms it is not an ancestor. His sealed jar holds HyperNorm dust classified as either rubbish or heritage. A dissonant card points out it can be both. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Vor Entsorgung ist die Ahnenfrage zu klären.

variant_notes.note_en: Cannot discard the dust until somebody confirms it is not an ancestor.
